# Delivery evidence

## Scope

This document defines the evidence needed before a maintained document can be
reported complete.

## Required premises

The required basis consists of semantic correctness, a usable reader route,
and an observation that the intended reader can apply the relevant rule.
Static reachability establishes only that a path exists.

## Acceptance

Report delivery complete only when the required basis has been established for
the final content and its active route.
